Class Scenario

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.model.AbstractScenarioTensorAndEngineConfig
org.ether.society.model.Scenario
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Scenario extends AbstractScenarioTensorAndEngineConfig

Scenario

Core operational model for an Ether planetary and civilizational simulation configuration.
Encapsulates planetary boundary conditions, demographic initial stocks ($N_0, K_0, E_0, F_0, I_0$), H3 spatial resolution, temporal step size ($\Delta t$), cultural and geological tensor configurations, Tier 2 cliodynamic engine toggles, and determinism settings.

Canonical built-in historical, future, and exoplanetary scenarios are loaded directly from data/presets/scenarios/*.json via PresetStorageService.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
